title: Part
spec: Create a new coordinate system with Euler angles set to zero and a translation vector also set to zero. On the first face, draw the first loop by starting a line from the origin (0.0, 0.0) to (0.75, 0.0), then another line from (0.75, 0.0) to (0.75, 0.0375). Next, draw an arc from (0.75, 0.0375) to (0.7125, 0.075) with a midpoint at (0.739, 0.064). Continue with a line from (0.7125, 0.075) to (0.0, 0.075) and a final line from (0.0, 0.075) back to the origin. For the second loop, start a line from (0.1125, 0.0188) to (0.1875, 0.0188), then from (0.1875, 0.0188) to (0.1875, 0.0562), followed by a line from (0.1875, 0.0562) to (0.1125, 0.0562), and finally a line from (0.1125, 0.0562) back to (0.1125, 0.0188). In the third loop, draw a circle centered at (0.375, 0.0375) with a radius of 0.0225. For the fourth loop, start with an arc from (0.5625, 0.03) to (0.5738, 0.0188) with a midpoint at (0.5658, 0.022), then a line from (0.5738, 0.0188) to (0.6262, 0.0188). Follow this with an arc from (0.6262, 0.0188) to (0.6375, 0.03) with a midpoint at (0.6342, 0.022), a line from (0.6375, 0.03) to (0.6375, 0.045), and an arc from (0.6375, 0.045) to (0.6262, 0.0562) with a midpoint at (0.6342, 0.053). Complete the loop with a line from (0.6262, 0.0562) to (0.5738, 0.0562), an arc from (0.5738, 0.0562) to (0.5625, 0.045) with a midpoint at (0.5658, 0.053), and a final line from (0.5625, 0.045) back to (0.5625, 0.03). Scale the entire sketch by a factor of 0.75. Transform the scaled sketch into a three-dimensional model by rotating it with Euler angles set to zero and translating it with a vector also set to zero. Extrude the sketch 0.0375 units along the normal direction without extruding in the opposite direction. Define a boolean operation to create a new solid body with the extruded sketch. The final dimensions of the part are a length of 0.75 units, a width of 0.075 units, and a height of 0.0375 units.

import cadquery as cq

# Create a new workplane
r = cq.Workplane("XY")

# Create the outer boundary of the rectangular bar
r = r.moveTo(0.0, 0.0) \
     .lineTo(0.75, 0.0) \
     .lineTo(0.75, 0.0375) \
     .threePointArc((0.739, 0.064), (0.7125, 0.075)) \
     .lineTo(0.0, 0.075) \
     .lineTo(0.0, 0.0) \
     .close()

# Create the first hole
r = r.moveTo(0.1125, 0.0188) \
     .lineTo(0.1875, 0.0188) \
     .lineTo(0.1875, 0.0562) \
     .lineTo(0.1125, 0.0562) \
     .close()

# Create the second hole
r = r.moveTo(0.375, 0.0375) \
     .circle(0.0225)

# Create the third hole
r = r.moveTo(0.5625, 0.03) \
     .threePointArc((0.5658, 0.022), (0.5738, 0.0188)) \
     .lineTo(0.6262, 0.0188) \
     .threePointArc((0.6342, 0.022), (0.6375, 0.03)) \
     .lineTo(0.6375, 0.045) \
     .threePointArc((0.6342, 0.053), (0.6262, 0.0562)) \
     .lineTo(0.5738, 0.0562) \
     .threePointArc((0.5658, 0.053), (0.5625, 0.045)) \
     .lineTo(0.5625, 0.03) \
     .close()

# Extrude the sketch
r = r.extrude(0.0375)

# The final model is represented as 'r'

import cadquery as cq

# Plate dimensions
L = 0.75      # X
W = 0.075     # Y
T = 0.0375    # Z

# Base plate with rounded right end
part = (
    cq.Workplane("XY")
    .box(L, W, T, centered=(False, False, False))
    .edges("|Z and >X")
    .fillet(0.03)
)

# Rectangular through hole (near left)
part = (
    part.faces(">Z")
    .workplane(origin=(0, 0, 0))
    .center(0.15, W / 2.0)
    .rect(0.067, 0.032)
    .cutThruAll()
)

# Circular through hole (center)
part = (
    part.faces(">Z")
    .workplane(origin=(0, 0, 0))
    .center(0.373, W / 2.0)
    .circle(0.019)
    .cutThruAll()
)

# Rounded slot (near right)
part = (
    part.faces(">Z")
    .workplane(origin=(0, 0, 0))
    .center(0.602, W / 2.0)
    .slot2D(0.076, 0.027, 0)
    .cutThruAll()
)

r = part

lanes.code:
import cadquery as cq

L, W, T = 0.7500, 0.0750, 0.0375
R = W / 2.0
x_end = L - R

# Base bar with a semicircular right end
base = (
    cq.Workplane("XY")
    .moveTo(0, 0)
    .lineTo(x_end, 0)
    .threePointArc((L, R), (x_end, W))
    .lineTo(0, W)
    .close()
    .extrude(T)
)

# Through-cut tools
z0, z1 = -0.001, T + 0.001

rect_hole = (
    cq.Workplane("XY")
    .rect(0.075, 0.030)
    .extrude(z1 - z0)
    .translate((0.160, R, z0))
)

round_hole = (
    cq.Workplane("XY")
    .circle(0.030 / 2.0)
    .extrude(z1 - z0)
    .translate((0.375, R, z0))
)

slot_len, slot_w = 0.075, 0.030
sr = slot_w / 2.0
xa = -(slot_len / 2.0 - sr)
xb = +(slot_len / 2.0 - sr)
slot_hole = (
    cq.Workplane("XY")
    .moveTo(xa, -sr)
    .lineTo(xb, -sr)
    .threePointArc((slot_len / 2.0, 0), (xb, sr))
    .lineTo(xa, sr)
    .threePointArc((-slot_len / 2.0, 0), (xa, -sr))
    .close()
    .extrude(z1 - z0)
    .translate((0.600, R, z0))
)

r = base.cut(rect_hole).cut(round_hole).cut(slot_hole)
